briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Reflect the Mirror Lake Sanctum: Elite Lock. Enter Mirror Lake Sanctum on Torii-Moon Mirror Road through The Torii-Moon Gate while the Gate remains Distortion Gate with ritual rerouting. Reference deity voice is Tsukuyomi, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the elite lock against Tengu Storm-Cedar Warden inside the Mirror Lake Sanctum and prove the active deity can endure the trial alone.

missionIntro.speaker: Tsukuyomi Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: A clean crossing leaves no false reflection behind. The Mirror Lake Sanctum will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the elite pressure of Torii-Moon Mirror Road made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: oni taboo zones that punish broken shrine law

victory.speaker: Tsukuyomi Divine Voice
victory.text: The mirror clears; what remains is permitted to pass.

defeat.speaker: Tsukuyomi Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Torii-Moon Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Sacred Kingdoms is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Mirror Lake Sanctum as part of Torii-Moon Mirror Road.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Mirror Lake Sanctum as a elite node in Torii-Moon Mirror Road; torii silhouettes, shrine lacquer red, white paper shide, braided shimenawa cords, mirror discs, foxfire blue, ink-wash smoke, cedar bark, moonlit silk, oni iron, tengu feather wind, dragon-rain scales, mask geometry, seasonal petals and ash.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
